command: STEM="session_$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-unregistered-map-codes"; mkdir -p "scratchpad/$STEM" && echo "$STEM" > scratchpad/CURRENT && cat scratchpad/CURRENT

STEM=$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT); export SCRATCH="/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/12490a0b-e6f6-5261-aee0-987260ea8dbe/scratchpad/guidebook-t-084"; mkdir -p "$SCRATCH" && cp data/guidebook.db "$SCRATCH/s.db" && sha256sum data/guidebook.db | cut -c1-16
H="Owner ratification 2026-11-19 — the third adjudication's resolutions are appended and ratified (OD-17, OD-46 to OD-48, OD-51, OD-52, OD-54, OD-62, OD-67, OD-69, OD-71's residue, OD-72, and the stack's design questions)"
GUIDEBOOK_DB_PATH="$SCRATCH/s.db" python3 scripts/db.py add-jurisdiction --code AR --kind country --approval-ref "$H" --session "$STEM" --dry-run 2>&1 | tail -6

grep -n 'def require_approval_heading' -A32 scripts/dbcore.py | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'def ledger_entry_names' -A22 scripts/dbcore.py | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'LEDGER_DELEGATED_PREFIX *=' scripts/dbcore.py

cat >> references/project-standards.md <<'EOF'

## Record 2026-11-20 — OD-46 applied: the seventeen codes the language-and-jurisdiction map holds and the registry lacks are admitted as declared, scoped-out

Written by the executor of T-084 in `session_2026-11-20-unregistered-map-codes`, and approved by the owner in chat on 2026-11-20 ("yeah, approve", answering the executor's report that the ledger append was the one blocker). **Not an owner statement of scope and it decides nothing new:** it applies the owner's ratification of 2026-11-19 (entry "Owner ratification 2026-11-19 — the third adjudication's resolutions are appended and ratified …") and names the codes it applies to, because `db.py add-jurisdiction` and `db.py set-pair-scope` refuse an approval entry that does not name the code (`dbcore.ledger_entry_names`), and that entry names none.

**The owner's words it rests on, quoted (typed, 2026-11-19):**

> "have Opus adjudicate all open decisions based upon long-term integrity re provenance and walkability as well as context from my prior rulings"
>
> "Sure, append. Ratify all."

**What those words ratified for OD-46** (the adjudication, `workplan/2026-11-12-bidirectional-pipeline/OPEN-DECISIONS-ADJUDICATION-3.md`, item 2): the codes `lang_jur_map` holds that `base_jurisdictions` lacks are admitted as declared jurisdictions whose pairs are scoped out; their pairs are not removed, because removal needs a hard-delete exception to "retire in place then" and erases the record of what was searched; scope stays OD-04's ("UN out; sub-national counts toward its country").

**The codes, derived and not typed as a count.** The set is the output of `select l.jurisdiction, group_concat(l.language) from lang_jur_map l left join base_jurisdictions b on b.jurisdiction_code = l.jurisdiction where b.jurisdiction_code is null group by 1` (T-084 section 3), read on 2026-11-20: AR (ES), AT (DE), CL (ES), CO (ES), CR (ES), CY (EN), EC (ES), ET (EN), GH (EN), GT (ES), MA (AR and FR), MX (ES), PE (ES), PH (EN), TH (EN), TZ (EN and SW), UY (ES). Each is a country.

**Readings.**

- [ASSUMPTION: "Ratify all" covers each of these codes — basis: the question OD-46 asked was of every code the map holds and the registry lacks, not of a named list].
- [ASSUMPTION: "scoped-out" is the `scope_status` value `scoped-out` of `lang_jur_map` on every pair of these codes, and `base_jurisdictions.kind` is `country` for each — basis: the column's own CHECK holds `in-scope` and `scoped-out` only, and each code is a national one].
- If the owner meant fewer codes, or a code in scope, a later owner line amends this one (CLAUDE.md rule 0).

CONDITION: any session admitting one of the codes above to `base_jurisdictions` or scoping one of its `lang_jur_map` pairs; T-084; T-085.
ACTION: (1) Admit each code with `db.py add-jurisdiction --kind country` and set each of its pairs to `scoped-out` with `db.py set-pair-scope`, pointing at this entry. (2) Remove no pair. (3) Treat the two assumptions above as unratified until the owner's words state them.
DATE: 2026-11-20 — record of the 2026-11-19 ratification.
EOF
grep -c '^## Record 2026-11-20 — OD-46 applied' references/project-standards.md

STEM=$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT); SCRATCH=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/12490a0b-e6f6-5261-aee0-987260ea8dbe/scratchpad/guidebook-t-084; cp data/guidebook.db "$SCRATCH/s.db"
H="Record 2026-11-20 — OD-46 applied: the seventeen codes the language-and-jurisdiction map holds and the registry lacks are admitted as declared, scoped-out"
export GUIDEBOOK_DB_PATH="$SCRATCH/s.db"
PAIRS=$(python3 -I -c "
import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
for l,j in c.execute('select l.language,l.jurisdiction from lang_jur_map l left join base_jurisdictions b on b.jurisdiction_code=l.jurisdiction where b.jurisdiction_code is null order by 2,1'): print(l,j)")
echo "$PAIRS" | wc -l
for J in $(echo "$PAIRS" | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u); do python3 scripts/db.py add-jurisdiction --code $J --kind country --approval-ref "$H" --session "$STEM" 2>&1 | tail -1; done
echo "$PAIRS" | while read L J; do python3 scripts/db.py set-pair-scope --language $L --jurisdiction $J --scope-status scoped-out --approval-ref "$H" --session "$STEM" 2>&1 | tail -1; done
sha256sum data/guidebook.db | cut -c1-16
